model.name: Standard Public Test reward model
notes: First-time-only introductory rewards are intentionally excluded from projections.
Mission objectives may change between updates; this model focuses on recurring missions and availability windows.
The schedule is stored in UTC and localized by the browser.
Draft 11 uses bundled copies of the shared Wargaming resource artwork; production can point the same icon fields at wows-shared-data URLs.
Mission types choose from a small set of supported UI strategies; mission data does not contain executable behavior.
A reward defined on a mission type is shared by every mission in that type; a reward defined on an individual mission applies only to that mission.
A mission type appears in the local-time schedule only when it contains a schedule object.

sessionLogin.label: Session login
sessionLogin.help: Automatically awarded the first time you log in during each enabled Public Test session.

missionTypes.label: Windowed Missions
missionTypes.help: The objective chain can vary, but the recurring reward package is the main time-sensitive PTS reward.

simple.help: Choose the PTS days you expect to play and how often you expect to catch each recurring mission window.

schedule.subtitle: Play during one of the listed four-hour windows
schedule.help: Every Windowed Mission uses the same recurring reward package.

missionTypes.label: Day-Long Missions
missionTypes.help: Recurring missions that remain available for a full PTS day instead of only a four-hour timed window.

simple.help: How often do you expect to complete the longer Day 2 and Day 3 missions? Exact objectives may vary between PTS updates.

schedule.subtitle: Available for the full listed mission day
schedule.help: Every Day-Long Mission currently uses the same recurring reward package.

missions.label: Day 2 Mission
missions.help: Historically available throughout Day 2 of each session. Exact objective may vary. Historically refreshes at 02:00 UTC.

missions.label: Day 3 Mission
missions.help: Historically available throughout Day 3 of each session. Exact objective may vary. Historically refreshes at 02:00 UTC.

missionTypes.label: Round-Long Community Token Missions
missionTypes.help: Longer missions whose objectives vary by update. In the standard model these reward Community Tokens and can be completed once per session.

simple.help: How much of the longer Community Token mission set do you expect to finish? Advanced mode lets you choose the individual missions.

missions.label: 1,000 CT mission
missions.help: Usually tied to one of the major features being tested.

missions.label: 500 CT mission
missions.help: Usually tied to a secondary feature or battle type being tested.

missions.label: 1,600 CT Special Task
missions.help: A larger recurring round mission whose objective changes between updates.
